samples.question: REFERENCE has four identity-colored sockets joined into two separate pairs by cyan connectors. The magenta ring marks one socket. LOOKUP has the same four identity colors rearranged; each socket has a colored square tag directly below it. Find the reference socket joined to the ringed socket, match its identity color in LOOKUP, and report that socket's tag color. Answer red, blue, gold, or purple.
